score.notes: Diagnostic only: hierarchy 5, ownability 5, craft 5, accessibility 4, accuracy/provenance 5, usefulness 4. It is eligible for human review, not automatically approved.

known_risks: Human approval and an independent semantic review remain required before publication or series-scale reuse.
The one-sheet is a save/open artifact at 360 pixels; use the carousel as the primary mobile release.
Third-party mark permission remains use-context dependent; plain text is the mandatory fallback when the publication context changes.
The current direction should be compared with one meaningfully different human-reviewed direction before becoming a frozen series template.
